role: Individual upstream a11y source review; native/independent admission remains pending
decision: The complete three-file upstream patch changes current MDC pagination buttons to divs to avoid focusable aria-hidden warnings, and removes three native button reset declarations. Both genuine minimum peers contain the div templates. Earlier source notes claimed the owned controls remained buttons, while captured pre-repair sources were divs. The user requires16 HTML/CSS structure and delegates conservative TypeScript choices: restore actual native buttons and resets, prevent default pointer focus through existing MouseEvent handler, retain disabled/tab-stop/click/hold semantics, and stop work after reentrant destruction. Full parsed historical trees (two existing optional label bindings explicit), three nonempty Sass mixins at three configurations/two minimum CDK sources and actual owned lifecycle/Event controls support the repair. Actual focus, scroll geometry, assistive-technology diagnostics, native both-line tests and fresh independent review remain pending. No terminal SHA or full G11 pass is claimed.
proposed_disposition: owned legacy structure retained; narrow local focus/lifetime adaptation, current MDC peer unchanged
